subject: prd/maintenance-jobs
statement: When installation or job execution produces a lifecycle event or outcome, the CLI shall append inspectable structured evidence to the enrolled repository's `.pyxis/maintenance/logs.jsonl`.
rationale: Debugging and audit require one local stream
fit_criterion: Success/failure/timeout/skip/pre-claim-refusal fixtures produce versioned correlated records with available identity, config/route, phase/cause, timings, delivery and artifact references; concurrent writes do not interleave records; the journal is Git-ignored and credential-free
